title: Linux Engineer
description:
We are looking for Linux Engineers to join the team that maintains the critical infrastructure underlying the rest of Jane Street's technology. Our group includes hard-working Systems Engineers, Administrators and Programmers, tasked with maintaining and improving the platform that powers Jane Street's production trading systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Debugging kernel performance
- Developing management tools
- Resolving production issues in real time
- Deployment automation and scalable configuration management
- Obsessive monitoring and observability

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing/troubleshooting Linux systems
- Exposure to Linux environments through software development, IT operations, or similar field
- Interested in systems programming and administration
- Willing to learn OCaml (no prior experience required)
- Able to analyze and deconstruct technical problems
- Knowledge of operating system fundamentals, especially Linux
- Confident with Unix command line and basic shell scripting
- Basic understanding of network protocols
- Comfortable with fundamental programming concepts

Plus Skills:
- Practical experience with modern Linux systems and systems programming (C, sockets, virtual memory, process life cycle)
- Intermediate/advanced knowledge of troubleshooting tools (gdb, perf, DTrace, eBPF, SystemTap)
- Knowledge of modern computer architecture techniques (PCIe, NVMe, NUMA)
- Strong programmer in any language
- Fluent in English

ai_analysis.summary: This candidate is an exceptional graduate match for a Linux Engineer role, demonstrating deep understanding and practical application of Linux internals and systems programming through a robust project portfolio. While professional experience in real-time production issues is limited due to their graduate status, their strong technical foundation and explicit interest position them well for growth within Jane Street's infrastructure team.
resume_tips: Quantify leadership and impact in 'Head of Teaching Assistants' by detailing specific system improvements or technical achievements from supervised projects.
Explicitly list any exposure to modern computer architecture techniques like PCIe, NVMe, or NUMA within projects or the 'Embedded & Hardware' skill section, if applicable.
Enhance descriptions for projects like 'Linux System Tracing & Storage' to highlight aspects of deployment automation and scalable configuration management.
Ensure 'monitoring' and 'observability' keywords are prominently featured where relevant in projects or experiences.
